name: Chef Hand-off for MDL3
description: Lets Chef Shared Loader (and the mods made for it, such as HUDdle and Treasure Radar) run next to MDL3. MDL3 must have the higher priority (it wins the game's boot); this addon, started by MDL3, hands the game to Chef a few seconds after the game starts (the hand-off in Chef's own documentation, 'For other loaders'). Before that it takes the Chef mods that MDL3 has 'started' without Chef off package.loaded, so that Chef starts them properly, and it takes MDL3's own callbacks off the globals while Chef loads and puts them back behind Chef's, so that Chef 1.5's hang watchdog does not time them (0.2.1; 0.2.2 closes a gap the first real run on Chef 1.5.1 showed, and writes down what it finds). Does nothing when Chef is not installed or already running. Writes chef_handoff.log into %APPDATA%\Arrowhead\Helldivers2. Needs MDL3 and Chef Shared Loader 1.2.0 or newer (tested in the game with 1.4.1, and with 1.5.1 on 0.2.1), with MDL3 at a higher priority than Chef.
